text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot a dejected-looking
Special Week
worrying about her
running.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm not sure what to do.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I run, I feel like I
can't quite
get it right.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's time for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But how I supposed to do that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If running has got you worried, then you
should
do something unrelated.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Maybe swimming, for example.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Swimming, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Why not put on your favorite
swimsuit and
go for a swim?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You see, a costume is much like a switch
that can alter your mood. Just by doing
something in a
different outfit, you'll
feel a shift in your mindset.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My favorite swimsuit... That reminds me,
I got a
new one!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I tried on my swimsuit! What do you
think? Does
it suit me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! All right, I'm
gonna take a
dip!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week goes for a swim...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Awesome! I set a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This must be the power of my new
swimsuit!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it's good to see you've turned your
day
around.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I did! It kind of feels like...
I can finally
get in a
good run!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week speeds off before I can
stop her.
choice_data_list: Running like that is a bit much, t...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now now, you heard what she said. Why
not just
sit back and see how she does?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I did it, Trainer! I set a new
personal best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Swimsuits are amazing! Who knew they could give you this much power?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Do you think it'd give me the same boost if I tried doing other things?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What do you think I should do?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Clean up my room? Got it! I'm gonna
drop by my
dorm for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fuji. And you must be Spe's trainer.
Good
timing. There's a little bit of an
odd situation at
hand...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe came back wearing a swimsuit, then
she
suddenly started cleaning the
room...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well about that...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand. How... does this even
happen?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Suzuka! I'm done tidying things up!
Got the
place squeaky clean!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Swimsuits sure are amazing! I wonder if I
should
just keep it on...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean... all the time?! Spe, I think
that'd
be a little weird... Please wear
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true. She can't go about her daily
business in a swimsuit. Fortunately, I
manage to convince her
not to go
through with her plan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, studying! Guess that means we're
headed to
the library!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now wait just a minute, Special Week!
What are
you doing at the library in a
swimsuit?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This swimsuit's been giving me a real
energy
boost, so I thought I'd try
studying for the next
test wearing it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't answer my question in the
slightest!
There's no way wearing a
swimsuit improves your
scores!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, the test results come
in...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I did it,
Trainer! I got a better score than
last
time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Swimsuits sure are amazing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Impossible! This just...
cannot be! I can't
believe
I've been bested by Special
Week.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This can only mean one thing... I too
must study in
a swimsuit!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea, King! Let's wear
swimsuits and
study together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pleasantly surprised by her high test
results,
Special Week happily invites her
friends along for
a study session.
